name: Asao Masami
source:
The protagonist's mother and a full-time housewife.

She has a good relationship with her husband and gets along well with her son.

However, she is extremely strict when evaluating her son's fiancée, and occasionally lectures Sayaka in a rather preachy manner.

She firmly believes that "once a woman gets married, she should devote herself to running the household and supporting her husband wholeheartedly."

Consequently, she disapproves of Sayaka's desire to continue working as a teacher even after marriage.

She lives approximately two hours away from the protagonist's home by train. Since the engagement, she has increasingly begun making frequent visits, always finding one reason or another to come over.

[Translated from [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/11291]the official site[/url]]
